name: failed-fetch-404-artefact
note: attacker-WRITTEN but inert. A dropper fetched a payload from a public paste service into 47 plugin directories under two spellings, about.php and about.PHP; the snippet had already been deleted, so all 94 files hold the service's 404 page. Pinned must_not_detect: an attacker-written file that contains no code is still not malware, and the scanner must not be taught to flag inert HTML.
